FOOD FOR THOUGHT — EDITION 02: TEAM PREPARATION CHECKLIST

THE CHALLENGE
What should Swiggy build next for India's college students?
Discover a meaningful unmet need, validate it, design a new solution, and show
why Swiggy is uniquely positioned to deliver it sustainably. AI is optional.

ELIGIBILITY AND REGISTRATION
[ ] Students from eligible colleges in India; all batches and disciplines.
[ ] 2–4 team members, all from the same college.
[ ] Each student is in only one team.
[ ] Every member registers for Swiggy Student Rewards:
    https://swiggy.onelink.me/888564224/u631l8dw
[ ] Register the competition team by 30 October 2026.
    Official competition registration link will be announced.
    Student Rewards registration is a separate prerequisite, not competition entry.
[ ] No team member changes after registration closes.

UP TO FIVE SLIDES
1. Campus insight: behaviour, unmet need, operational challenge or opportunity.
2. Proposed solution: product, AI solution, tool, automation, marketing,
   partnership, operational improvement or community initiative.
3. User journey: how it works and how relevant students, restaurant partners,
   delivery partners or internal teams interact with and benefit from it.
4. Business impact: relevant adoption, transactions, frequency, retention,
   revenue, costs, efficiency, productivity or customer experience outcomes.
5. Execution plan: pilot, scaling, implementation, estimated cost, dependencies,
   risks and measurable success metrics. For AI-led ideas, explain AI's role
   and demonstrate a prototype/mock-up wherever feasible.

REQUIRED CAMPUS VALIDATION — INCLUDE AT LEAST ONE
[ ] Student survey, student interviews, merchant interviews, observations,
    a small experiment, or a prototype/concept test.

BEFORE SUBMITTING
[ ] Presentation has no more than five slides.
[ ] Explain why Swiggy should solve this need.
[ ] Support your estimates and make assumptions clear.
[ ] Submit through the competition platform in its prescribed format by the deadline.
    Submission deadline and platform instructions will be announced.

SELECTION
AI-assisted screening -> top 50 progress towards finale selection ->
6–7 teams present in person to Swiggy leadership.
Finale date and location: to be announced.
Jury criteria: quality of insight, originality, business potential, execution
feasibility, presentation and responses to questions.
Cash prize amounts and detailed reward terms: to be announced.

Questions: swiggyforstudents@swiggy.in
